data.narrative:
Asterra, a Series A space and aerospace company founded by Lauren Guy, has raised $20M+ to date. The valuation analysis employs two applicable methods against a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $20M raised proxy, yielding $40M. Peer-median analysis draws from three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables: Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B Seed). The median across this set is $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B–$2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures. The public sector (Space & Aerospace) trades at a 24.4x P/S median across six tickers, but target revenue data is unavailable.

Triangulating the two applicable methods produces a range of $34M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $670M. The substantial spread reflects tension between early-stage funding history and peer valuations skewed toward later-stage, higher-profile operators. Key uncertainties include revenue traction (unmeasured), path to Series B timing and size, and whether peer comparables—dominated by established programs—appropriately anchor an early-stage frontier-tech entry. Narrowing the range requires disclosure of current ARR or revenue run-rate metrics.
